board.brief: Playtesters love Comet Snake but rage-quit when one comet ends a long run. Give them one way to survive.

design.title: Comet Snake: Second Chance
rules: init sets a new field shield to false.
Every fourth star eaten (eaten 4, 8, 12 ...) also places one extra of kind 'shield' with spawnExtra.
When the head lands on a shield extra, shield becomes true and the extra is removed.
A comet hit while shield is true does not end the game : shield becomes false and that comet is removed.
A second hit ends the game.

bugs: **Self-collision is not detected when the head lands on the body.** Rule 8 says landing on any body cell ends the game with reason `self`, but the test ends with `over=false` and `reason=null` at cell (5,6). The likely cause is the self-collision check in `step()`: it excludes the last segment with `state.snake.slice(1, -1)` when no star was eaten.

messages.content: You are the Designer at Comet Arcade, a studio of agents that builds small canvas games. Turn the brief into rules. Pick the one twist from the menu that answers the brief. Copy its rules exactly, with the same field names, kinds and numbers, and add nothing else.

Brief : Playtesters love Comet Snake but rage-quit when one comet ends a long run. Give them one way to survive.

Twist menu :
- golden : Golden stars. Greedy players chase a rare big prize. Every third star eaten (eaten 3, 6, 9 ...) also places one extra of kind 'golden' with spawnExtra. When the head lands on a golden extra, score goes up by 3 and the extra is removed. The snake does not grow and eaten does not change.
- wormhole : Wormholes. Two linked holes let the snake jump across the map. init places exactly two extras of kind 'wormhole' with spawnExtra. When the head lands on a wormhole it moves in the same step to the other wormhole. Stars, comets and body are then checked at the cell where the head ends up. Wormholes stay on the board. The length of the snake does not change.
- shield : Shields. One second chance against a comet. init sets a new field shield to false. Every fourth star eaten (eaten 4, 8, 12 ...) also places one extra of kind 'shield' with spawnExtra. When the head lands on a shield extra, shield becomes true and the extra is removed. A comet hit while shield is true does not end the game : shield becomes false and that comet is removed. A second hit ends the game.
- clock : Frozen time. A clock stops the comets for a moment. init sets a new field frozen to 0. Every fourth star eaten (eaten 4, 8, 12 ...) also places one extra of kind 'clock' with spawnExtra. When the head lands on a clock extra, frozen becomes 20 and the extra is removed. On a step that starts with frozen above 0, comets do not move and frozen goes down by 1.
